fields.description: The category's SLA configuration this rule overrides. Fixed once the rule is created.
fields.label: SLA Configuration

fields.description: The category of the SLA configuration. Follows the configuration.
fields.label: Service Category

fields.description: A name for the rule, for example Meher input season. Shown to administrators only.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Set by the system: the rule names no type, no area and no window. It is the category's SLA wherever no narrower rule matches. Every category with an SLA has one; it cannot be deleted or narrowed.
fields.label: Base Rule

fields.description: The escalation rung this rule's days are for, e.g. Nodal Officer (L1). Blank: the days for the whole case.
fields.label: Role Level

fields.description: Blank applies to every type of the category. A type must belong to the rule's category.
fields.label: Grievance Type

fields.description: Blank applies everywhere. An area also covers every area inside it.
fields.label: Administrative Area

fields.description: A recurring window, the same every year. Leave all four blank for a rule that applies all year. A start after the end wraps the year end, for example October to April.
fields.label: Seasonal Window

fields.description: A case this rule matches is classified once, on its filing date. Of the rules that match a case the most specific wins: a type's rule before the category's, a narrower area before a wider one, a windowed rule before an all-year one.
fields.label: When the Rule Matches

fields.description: Turnaround in working days for a case this rule matches.
fields.label: SLA Days

fields.description: The case is handled as Urgent, with priority Urgent.
fields.label: Urgent

fields.description: Set by the system from Urgent: Urgent for an urgent rule, blank otherwise.
fields.label: Priority
